en:
EMPTY CORE = structural betrayal (measured, exact):
  glove game -> Shapley (2/3, 1/6, 1/6), core NON-empty (a stable split exists)
  3-player majority -> Shapley (1/3, 1/3, 1/3), core EMPTY (no stable split)
The empty core is the SLS situation: coalitions are inherently unstable and WILL break -
so N-player 'safe' play cannot anchor to a Nash/core equilibrium (Contribution #2).

en:
MEASURED (5-seed paired sweep; gap = coalition score shapley - sparse):
  alpha = 0 (proxy, synergy 0.3):  +0.0376 +/- 0.0103   ** (~4.4x sparse)
  alpha = 0 (counterfactual):      +0.0128 +/- 0.0026   **
  alpha >= 0.3 (any cell):         -0.001 ... -0.004     (negative - the DEAD ZONE)
Effect GROWS with game size; the cheap proxy beats the expensive counterfactual.

MEASURED - which POOL you decompose decides the shape:
  skill-ladder pool  -> cyclic ~0.25-0.31 (a LADDER)
  coalition pool     -> cyclic ~0.57-0.69 (a WHEEL)
Strongly cyclic, confirming the Step-10 direction, but just
under strict dominance - the 2-type projection likely discards
3-/4-player coalition effects (Contribution #3, open).
bg:
ИЗМЕРЕНО - от кой ПУЛ разлагате зависи формата:
  пул от нива на умения  -> цикличен ~0.25-0.31 (СТЪЛБА)
  коалиционен пул     -> цикличен ~0.57-0.69 (КОЛЕЛО)
Силно цикличен, потвърждава посоката от Стъпка 10, но точно
под строго доминиране - 2-типната проекция вероятно изхвърля
ефекти от коалиции с 3-/4-ма играчи (Принос #3, отворен).
